name: Wisconsin
agency: Wisconsin Department of Transportation (WisDOT), Division of Motor Vehicles

teen.supervisedHours: 50 hours, at least 10 of them in darkness, verified by the sponsor (handbook p. 6; permits issued before July 11, 2021: 30 hours with 10 at night, WisDOT)
teen.holdPermit: At least 6 months and age 16 (handbook p. 6); no moving-violation conviction in those 6 months (Wis. Stat. 343.085(1)(b); WisDOT)
teen.nightLimit: Probationary under 18, first 9 months: midnight to 5 a.m. alone only between home, school and/or work, or with a qualified licensed adult (handbook p. 7). Restrictions extended 6 months after a moving violation, a restriction violation, or a suspension (p. 7)
teen.passengerLimit: Probationary under 18, first 9 months: any number of immediate family, one qualified licensed adult (instructor or spouse 19+, or person 21+, 2 years experience), and one other person (handbook p. 6)
teen.phone: Instruction permit and probationary license holders may use a cell phone only to report an emergency (handbook p. 49; Wis. Stat. 346.89(4)(a))

bac.under21: absolute sobriety: 0.00, any amount (handbook p. 49; Wis. Stat. 346.63(2m)); 3-month suspension (343.30(1p)), $200 forfeiture (346.65(2q)), 4 demerit points (343.32(2)(bj))

notes: Handbook: Wisconsin Motorists' Handbook (BDS126), 2026 edition (cover says 2026; PDF dated July 3, 2026). Printed page = PDF page minus 4. Read 2026-10-09.

Knowledge test 50 questions, 40 correct (80%); separate highway signs test 15 questions, 12 correct (80%) (handbook p. 1). Ages 15-17 may take the knowledge test online for $10 (p. 1); the online test is in English and Spanish (WisDOT knowledge page).

Test languages (Class D knowledge and signs): English, ASL, Burmese, Chinese, Croatian, Hmong, Polish, Russian, Serbian, Somali, Spanish (WisDOT knowledge.aspx, read 2026-10-09). Handbook p. 54: tests have audio and many languages.
Permit: at least 15 and enrolled in driver education including behind-the-wheel, if under 18 (p. 5). Under 18 needs an adult sponsor (p. 3).

Supervisor for a permit holder: licensed 2+ years, regular license, in the front passenger seat; instructor 19+, parent/guardian/spouse 19+, or person 21+ (with parent written authorization if the driver is under 18). In darkness: instructor or licensed person 25+ (p. 5).

Speed: residential 25 mph unless posted; school zone with children present 15 mph; outlying districts 35 mph (p. 10). Freeways 70 mph where posted, expressways 65 (Wis. Stat. 346.57(4)(gm), not in handbook).
Move Over: handbook p. 51 (move out of the lane nearest the stopped emergency vehicle, or slow down). 2025 Wisconsin Act 54 (published Dec. 10, 2025) added disabled vehicles (Wis. Stat. 346.072).
School bus with red lights flashing: stop at least 20 feet away, both directions; no stop on a divided highway on the other side (p. 51).
First OWI (no aggravating factors) is a forfeiture, not a crime (Wis. Stat. 346.65(2)(am)1.); not in the handbook. Implied consent refusal: at least one year loss of license (p. 49).
The handbook does not state the adult 0.08 limit, the under-21 penalties, the freeway limit, or the phone forfeiture amount.
Statutes checked in the Wisconsin Statutes updated through Oct. 1, 2026 (docs.legis.wisconsin.gov).
